hints.title: Global Affine Transformation State
hints.text: Represent global operations as scale A and offset B such that any original value v becomes (A * v + B) modulo prime.

hints.title: Modular Inverse Normalization
hints.text: When appending val, store its normalized base form: (val - B) * modular_inverse(A) modulo prime.

hints.title: Transformation Updating
hints.text: addAll(inc) updates B = (B + inc) modulo prime; multAll(m) updates A = (A * m) and B = (B * m) modulo prime.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of appended values
complexity.notes: Fermat Little Theorem computes inverse in O(log MOD) time, while all sequence transformations run in O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through every element on addAll and multAll takes O(N) per call, causing timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Global multiplier and adder reduce range modifications to constant-time scalar operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Lazy affine transformation tracking using modular arithmetic and Fermat Little Theorem inversion.
